    "Limited to one project on the free plan, restricting broader use",

    "May lack advanced features or customization compared to competitors"

  "overall_experience": "The Director of Membership likely found Basecamp to be a relatively easy-to-use tool for basic project and task management, especially for managing multi-collaboration projects and action items within a broadcast media context. Its simplicity would have been a benefit for getting started, though the limitations of the free plan and the need to manually add tools for each project might have become a point of friction over time. While sufficient for core needs, they might have noted its less extensive feature set compared to other project management solutions."
